name: igor-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for the Claude desktop app

plugins.name: session-banners
plugins.description: A macOS banner when a Claude desktop app session finishes, opening that session on click; its helper app also shows pr-watch's banners

plugins.name: status-bar
plugins.description: A row above the message box with the session's Linear ticket, its state and Figma frames, the pull request's preview links, and how far the merged change has deployed

plugins.name: pr-watch
plugins.description: A macOS banner and a note in the session when the session's pull request is approved, turns ready to merge, leaves the merge queue, merges, closes, or deploys or fails to deploy, never a message in your name

plugins.name: worktree-warmup
plugins.description: Installs a new or stale worktree's dependencies in the background when its session starts, with progress above the message box; Claude's commands that need them wait
